name: YAGEO-cc-x7r
title: CC series X7R multilayer ceramic chip capacitors, general purpose and high capacitance, 6.3 V to 250 V
summary: Surface-mount multilayer ceramic capacitors in the class 2 X7R dielectric, sizes 0201 to 2220, rated 6.3 V to 250 V, from 100 pF to 47 µF in ± 5%, ± 10% or ± 20% tolerance. Capacitance stays within ± 15% from –55 °C to +125 °C. Nickel-barrier tin terminations, lead-free, RoHS and halogen-free, MSL 1, on paper or blister tape reels. The range is split into general purpose and high capacitance parts, which have different life and damp heat limits.
key_figures: Rins ≥ 10 GΩ or Rins × Cr ≥ 500/100/50 s, whichever is less

operation.text: Stacked metal electrode layers sit inside a ceramic dielectric body, alternate layers running out to opposite ends; the many layers give a large capacitance in a small volume. Each end termination is lead-free, tin plated over a nickel barrier (NiSn).
PCs, hard disks, game consoles, DVD players, video cameras, mobile phones and data processing.
Delivered on reels of tape; nickel-barrier ends; RoHS and halogen-free; moisture sensitivity level 1.

Tests are run at 15 °C to 35 °C, 25% to 75% relative humidity and 86 kPa to 106 kPa (IEC 60068-1, 5.3) unless a test names other conditions. A part is measured only once it has reached the measuring temperature; a test's recovery period normally brings it there.
Class II capacitance and loss are read at 20 °C, 24 hours after annealing: at 1 kHz and 1 Vrms up to 10 µF (0.5 Vrms for parts rated 6.3 V or less), and at 120 Hz and 0.5 Vrms above 10 µF.
Before temperature cycling, soldering heat, damp heat and endurance tests the part is baked at 150 °C (+0/–10 °C) for 1 hour and rested 24 hours at room temperature.

Sizes 0402 and smaller and sizes 1210 and larger are reflow soldered only. In 0603, 0805 and 1206, values up to 1.0 µF, 2.2 µF and 4.7 µF respectively may be wave or reflow soldered; larger values are reflow only.

Each value is either a general purpose or a high capacitance part. High capacitance parts mostly take the endurance test at 1.5 × Ur where general purpose parts take 2 × Ur (the endurance test voltage table gives each value), and their limits are wider after bending (±12.5%), damp heat and endurance (±20%).
Values off the E6 series are made on request, and ± 5% parts are confirmed with sales before an order.
